title: GitLab Audit Events Overview
description: A GitLab instance's audit events: users and addresses, failed logins, members and authorizations, merge requests, project activity, access tokens and the Cloud SIEM signals they raise.

definition.content:
**GitLab audit events** record who did what on a GitLab instance: sign-ins and failed logins, access tokens created, rotated and revoked, members and their roles, OAuth applications authorized, merge request approvals and merges, approval rules, project and group settings, CI/CD variables and runners. This dashboard follows the connected instance's (or group's) audit events, the users and addresses behind them, and the Cloud SIEM signals their detection rules raise.

Connect GitLab in [Integrations → GitLab Audit Events](/integrations/gitlab-audit-events): ObserveCraft reads the audit events API every minute (GitLab Premium or Ultimate), with no access to ObserveCraft needed.
